target.scope: worker run terminal emitters + scripts/derive-opportunity-readiness.mjs + tests

problem: Positive worker completion state COMPLETE is emitted by durable runs while dynamic readiness accepts only exact DONE, so a qualifying RETURN can strand dependency-gated successors as RETURN_WITHOUT_DONE.
acceptance: inventory positive terminal run states emitted by current worker paths and compare them with readiness accepted states
establish one canonical positive terminal contract or an explicit compatibility mapping without weakening negative terminal handling
add falsification tests proving COMPLETE/DONE interoperability is intentional and fail-closed for negative or ambiguous states
demonstrate the Alumnos Teacher REUSE evidence no longer silently strands its local integration path without rewriting historical evidence
do not mutate queue authority or promote Current, Human Accepted, Served, or production /w
title: Unify worker terminal-state contract
mission: Reconcile worker-produced positive terminal run states with the strict dynamic-readiness consumer. Inventory emitters, define the canonical DONE/compatibility contract, add falsifiers, and prove the existing Alumnos Teacher REUSE lineage is handled intentionally without rewriting historical evidence or weakening fail-closed negative-state semantics.

unblock_value.reason: A positive-but-non-DONE terminal state can keep a dependency-gated successor blocked even when a durable qualifying RETURN exists.

regression_prevention.reason: The readiness compiler intentionally accepts only exact DONE; producers emitting alternate positive terminals can silently diverge from that contract across future worker waves.

information_gain.reason: The current evidence distinguishes a concrete protocol interoperability defect from missing-return recovery; stale recovery is inapplicable because the affected run already has a durable RETURN.

fail_if: the fix rewrites historical run evidence merely to satisfy readiness
negative or ambiguous terminal states become qualifying dependency success
producer and consumer terminal-state vocabularies remain divergent after the change
the proposal path mutates queue authority or promotes Current/Human Accepted/Served/production state
